author: bshastry
content: Hello! The progressive limit containers that Gloas introduces can lead to resource amplification attacks via unprivileged attacker e.g., gossip peer. For example, Fulu’s List[Withdrawal, MAX_WITHDRAWALS_PER_PAYLOAD] (16) becomes ProgressiveList[Withdrawal] in Gloas. If the progressive list is deserialized without a bounds check, it may be possible to crash a node due to an OOM exception as an unprivileged gossip peer. We have a concrete repro for Teku but wanted to bring this up for discussion since other CLs may also be vulnerable in certain edge-cases where caching of messages is involved e.g., unknown beacon root gossip. Happy to test this out further, running a cross CL scan at the moment 🙏
